title: COLLISION near Iran’s Qeshm sends MASSIVE ship SINKING — Fars footage
text:
COLLISION near Iran’s Qeshm sends MASSIVE ship SINKING — Fars footage"

"Nearly DOZEN sailors PULLED from DOOMED vessel"

"🔆🔅Iran rescues crew from maritime collision in the Strait of Hormuz"

"Early this morning, a collision between a bulk carrier and another vessel caused flooding and prompted an emergency evacuation order for one of the ships. All 23 crew members on board were successfully rescued by Iranian authorities and transferred to Qeshm Island."

"The maritime incident was reported around 2:00 AM local time north of Qeshm. According to preliminary investigations, a bulk carrier collided with another ship while underway at sea.
